title: Pickpocketing
description: This mod adds two special gloves that allow players, with a certain chance, to access other players' inventories or even their Ender Chest. Both items are balanced with low success rates to keep gameplay fair while enabling unique interactions.
body:
This mod adds two unique utility items that introduce a new layer of stealth and player interaction:

**Pickpocketing Gloves**
These gloves allow players to discreetly access the inventory of another player with a chance of success. Whether used for mischief or strategy, they add a risk-reward mechanic to close encounters.

![pickpocketing_gloves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93e4612e49c5985e9cc3afeec7ae273efd6ae21c_0.webp)

**Ender Pickpocketing Gloves**
An advanced variant crafted with End-related materials. These gloves grant a small chance to access another player’s Ender Chest, making them significantly more powerfulbut also rarer and less reliable.

![ender_pickpocketing_gloves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9503050e90b1f66f6257f29d9c00f328fea6980f_0.webp)

Both items are designed with balance in mind, featuring low success probabilities to prevent abuse while still enabling creative gameplay scenarios. Perfect for servers looking to add a touch of intrigue or competitive edge.
